---
title: "AutoSite documentation"
---

AutoSite is a program for identifying and characterizing binding pockets in
biological macromolecules.

## Running AutoSite

AutoSite needs the receptor in PDBQT format. The basic command is:

```bash
autosite -r receptor.pdbqt
```

It writes a log of the run and a folder of cluster points, feature points, cluster scores and
AutoGrid files. The [tutorial](tutorial-small-molecule.qmd) goes through a complete run and its
output files.

AutoSite can also be run through [AGFR](../agfr/index.qmd), which uses it to find pockets while
computing target files (option `-asv` selects AutoSite 1.0 or 1.1).
